summary: Loads point-cloud or point-field data from mesh, image, floating-point, ASCII, URL, or file-sequence sources into TOP channels.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Point file, folder sequence, or URL to load.

key_params.name: reloadpulse
key_params.note: Reload pulse used by current card/test surfaces.

key_params.name: red
key_params.note: Point field mapped into output red.

key_params.name: green
key_params.note: Point field mapped into output green.

key_params.name: blue
key_params.note: Point field mapped into output blue.

key_params.name: alpha
key_params.note: Point field mapped into output alpha.

key_params.name: playmode
key_params.note: Timeline-locked, specified index, or sequential playback for file sequences.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: File-sequence position in Specify Index mode.

key_params.name: prereadframes
key_params.note: Frames read ahead for smoother sequence playback.

key_params.name: frametimeout
key_params.note: Frame read timeout before skipping or substituting frames.

key_params.name: frametimeoutstrat
key_params.note: Strategy used when frame reads time out.

key_params.name: opentimeout
key_params.note: Timeout for opening the point source.

key_params.name: alwaysloadinitial
key_params.note: Load an initial frame even when sequence playback is not advancing.

key_params.name: asyncupload
key_params.note: Upload loaded frames asynchronously when supported.

common_gotchas: Only four point fields can be placed into a single TOP output; use Point File Select TOP for additional field outputs.
ASCII point files can infer headers or counts from early rows, so malformed first lines change channel detection.
Folder sequences are ordered alphanumerically unless filename-based indexing is selected.
Large EXR or point sequences need enough CPU, disk, timeout, pre-read, and upload budget to avoid playback stalls.
key_concepts: Loads point-cloud and point-field data from mesh, image, floating-point, ASCII, URL, and sequence sources.
All point fields can be loaded, but a single TOP output can expose only four channels at a time.
Point File Select TOP exposes additional field outputs from the same loaded source.
Playback, pre-read, timeout, and async upload controls are important for large point or EXR sequences.
